extracted.name: No Bake Cereal Cookies
extracted.description: This is a no-bake cookie or bar with a good peanut butter taste. Ready-made chocolate frosting tastes good spread on the top.
instruction_lines: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil. Add peanut butter and stir well. Remove from heat. Stir in cereal (see Cook's Note).
Pat into a lightly greased 9x13-inch pan, or drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Allow to cool before slicing bars.
